name: harmony-cc
description: Independent HarmonyOS competition workspace with native scheduler, cloud runtime, device workers and deliverables.

scripts.api:build: npm --workspace services/api-server run prisma:generate && npm --workspace services/api-server run build
scripts.api:test:cloud-db: npm --workspace services/api-server run prisma:generate && node scripts/test-cloud-database.mjs
scripts.api:zeabur:start: npm run api:zeabur:preflight && npm --workspace services/api-server run db:init && npm --workspace services/api-server run start
scripts.api:test:ci: npm run worker:test && npm run protocol:test && npm run artifact:migration:test && npm --workspace services/api-server run test:ci
scripts.architecture:test: npm run architecture:deps && npm run worker:test && npm run protocol:test && npm run artifact:migration:test && npm run cloud-shopping:test && npm run placement:test && npm run api:test:unit -- --runInBand
scripts.artifact:migration:test: npm --workspace services/api-server run prisma:generate && node scripts/test-artifact-migration.mjs
scripts.scheduler:v2:test: npm run core:test && npm run protocol:v2:test && npm run transport:test && npm run pc-agent:test && npm run coordinator:test && npm run architecture:deps
scripts.lab:test: npm --workspace @harmony/coordinator run build && npm --workspace @harmony/pc-agent run build && node tests/scheduler-lab/run.cjs
